source: src/native/PLAN.md section 3.2 (B1-B7). These thresholds are proposed by WP0.5 and are not ratified; the owner ratifies them. B8 (extension call budget) is enforced by the extension host in WP3.2 and is not measured here.

budgets.text: Hotkey to first frame, p95 on Linux. PLAN 3.2 gives 100 ms for macOS and Windows; those are not measured here.
Keystroke to updated result rows, p95, measured from the return of xdotool. The rig seeds the J29 clipboard (5k) and file (50k) counts; the 500 applications are only in the Go benchmarks.
Cold start to the ready log line. The palette is usable before the file index finishes; that part is not separately measured.
Idle hidden memory: PSS summed over the process tree (the Linux form of RSS).
Idle hidden CPU over 30 s, as a percentage of one core.
Palette shown, focused and idle: CPU over 10 s must stay below 1 percent of one core, so no continuous repaint.
Size of the default build, which is what ships. Installer size is tracked per release (WP5.1).
Goroutine growth over the soak loop, median of the last five samples minus median of the baseline.
Open descriptor growth over the soak loop, same medians.
Post-collection heap growth over the soak loop, same medians.
Share of soak samples where the heap rose from the previous one. Above this the heap grows monotonically.
